review:
A classic with cherries, sevens and BARs – and a clever respin ladder. Every win removes the lowest-paying symbol and gives a respin, and on the seventh respin in a row, 7 Deadly Free Spins begins with a 2x multiplier on every win.

Three scatters also give seven free spins with the six lowest symbols removed for the whole round. Up to 4,000x, 96.54% RTP. Climbing that ladder is surprisingly tense.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
